answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond that is released only after a steady pulse of verified useful work. Every completed task and peer check is carved into a marble-like public ledger, so a new identity starts with zero weight and must earn trust task by task. Creating thousands of fake agents then costs a bond per identity, while fraud forfeits the bond and wipes the accumulated weight. Auditors mark suspicious clusters with a saffron flag for extra review, making mass forgery expensive, slow, and easy to spot before it can sway votes or rewards.
